question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**coach**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about a former captain of an Indian wheelchair-cricket team who was forced to work as a labourer.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**coach**'.
 
• It means** 'a person who trains people to compete in certain sports'.** (विशेष खेल प्रतियोगिताओं के लिए लोगों को प्रशिक्षित करनेवाला व्यक्ति; खेल प्रशिक्षक, कोच)
 
 
• *Example: a tennis **coach**...*
 
 
 
• We tend to go for **Option 3** but it would be wrong because '**Teaching**' is focused on imparting knowledge and learning, where the teacher is in charge of the interaction. It has little to do with the student as an individual.
 
• '**Coaching**' is centered around the student. **Coaches** focus on the development and guidance of students.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *According to a news report, a former captain of the Indian wheelchair cricket team has now been forced to __**work**__ (1) as a labourer to support his family. In the context of the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown, the children he used to __**coach**__ (2) earlier have stopped coming to him for a few months. Their parents said there was no money to pay for their (3)______. Before the lockdown, he was giving coaching to wheelchair-bound children who were (4)______ in playing cricket. The coach has now returned to his village where his old parents live. He said to the reporter who interviewed him, “These are difficult times, but I know I will be able to (5)______ them,” with a smile on his face.*

45:T8d7,

The correct answer is '**training**'.
